mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recording_sessions ( account_id, analysis_report_checklist_id, original_file_name, storage_object_key, content_type, file_size, status ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{reportChecklistId}, #{originalFileName}, #{storageObjectKey}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT recording_session_id AS recordingSessionId, account_id AS accountId, analysis_report_checklist_id AS reportChecklistId, original_file_name AS originalFileName, storage_object_key AS storageObjectKey, content_type AS contentType, file_size AS fileSize, status, full_transcript AS fullTranscript, summary, failure_reason AS failureReason, started_at AS startedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, created_at AS createdAt, modified_at AS modifiedAt FROM recording_sessions WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId} AND account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT recording_session_id AS recordingSessionId, account_id AS accountId, analysis_report_checklist_id AS reportChecklistId, original_file_name AS originalFileName, storage_object_key AS storageObjectKey, content_type AS contentType, file_size AS fileSize, status, full_transcript AS fullTranscript, summary, failure_reason AS failureReason, started_at AS startedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, created_at AS createdAt, modified_at AS modifiedAt FROM recording_sessions WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_sessions SET status = #{status}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'TRANSCRIBING' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE started_at END, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId}
UPDATE recording_sessions SET full_transcript = #{fullTranscript}, status = #{status}, ended_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId}
UPDATE recording_sessions SET summary = #{summary}, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId}
UPDATE recording_sessions SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, ended_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recording_sessions ( account_id, analysis_report_checklist_id, status, created_at, modified_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{reportChecklistId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
